metadata.project: Lapaas AI Course Discovery & Enrolment Assistant
metadata.notes: Public website facts only. This is a course knowledge base, not a record of student results. Recheck changeable price and terms before a live demo.

verified_faq.question: What is Lapaas AI Product Engineering?
verified_faq.answer: A self-paced course covering AI product research, development, deployment and growth.

verified_faq.question: Who is this course for?
verified_faq.answer: The website includes students and freshers, business owners, and marketers and freelancers.

verified_faq.question: Do I need coding experience to start?
verified_faq.answer: No prior coding is needed to start, but learners must practise and build.
verified_faq.source_section: FAQ: I do not know coding

verified_faq.question: Which main topics are taught?
aliases: Does it teach RAG and agents?
verified_faq.answer: Topics include full-stack development, RAG, MCP, agents, automation, multimodal AI and launch.

verified_faq.question: Can I learn to build AI applications?
aliases: Will I learn to make a web app?
verified_faq.answer: The curriculum teaches workflows for full-stack AI apps, integrations and deployable products.
verified_faq.source_section: FAQ: What exactly will I learn to build

verified_faq.question: Does this course support portfolio projects?
aliases: Can I show projects on GitHub?
verified_faq.answer: Lapaas highlights working AI products, demos and case studies for student portfolios.
verified_faq.limitation: This does not guarantee a job or a finished portfolio for every student.

verified_faq.question: Is the course live or self-paced?
verified_faq.answer: It is self-paced, with no scheduled live classes in the current offer.
verified_faq.source_section: FAQ: Is this a live course

verified_faq.question: How long can I access the course?
verified_faq.answer: Course access lasts three months from activation.
verified_faq.source_section: FAQ: How long can I access the course

verified_faq.question: What is the course price?
verified_faq.answer: The listed fee is ₹2,999 as a one-time payment, including GST.

verified_faq.question: Where can I watch lessons and find course files?
verified_faq.answer: Lessons, slides, lab files and assignments are provided in the Edrilla app.
verified_faq.source_section: FAQ: Where do I access the course

verified_faq.question: Is there community support?
verified_faq.answer: The purchase includes Lapaas learner community access to ask Sahil questions.
verified_faq.source_section: FAQ: Can I ask Sahil questions

verified_faq.question: Will I receive a certificate?
verified_faq.answer: A Lapaas completion certificate is offered after finishing course requirements.
verified_faq.source_section: FAQ: Will I receive a certificate

verified_faq.question: Is there a refund policy?
aliases: What is the money back policy?
verified_faq.answer: The site advertises a 30-day refund policy, subject to Lapaas refund terms.
verified_faq.limitation: Do not promise an unconditional refund; the current eligibility terms must be reviewed.

verified_faq.question: Is EMI available?
verified_faq.answer: Eligible cards may show Razorpay EMI options at checkout.

verified_faq.question: How much study time should I plan?
aliases: Can I do this with college?
How much weekly time is needed?
verified_faq.answer: The website recommends several focused hours each week for lessons and project practice.
verified_faq.limitation: An exact total course duration in hours is not verified.

verified_faq.question: Does this course cover tools that may change over time?
aliases: Will the AI tools become outdated?
verified_faq.answer: The syllabus connects changing tools to product thinking, retrieval, evaluation and deployment.
verified_faq.source_section: FAQ: Will the tools become outdated

unverified_examples.question: Will I definitely get a job or internship?
unverified_examples.reason: No placement guarantee was verified on the official course page.

unverified_examples.question: What is the exact total video duration?
unverified_examples.reason: Total video hours were not clearly specified.

unverified_examples.question: Are premium AI tool credits included?
unverified_examples.reason: Included paid third-party subscriptions were not confirmed.

unverified_examples.question: Is it a mobile-only course?
unverified_examples.reason: Edrilla app is specified; exclusive mobile-only access is not established.

unverified_examples.question: Will I receive private one-to-one mentoring?
unverified_examples.reason: Community question access is confirmed; private mentoring is not.

unverified_examples.question: Can I extend access beyond three months?
unverified_examples.reason: Access extension terms are not described.

unverified_examples.question: Can I build absolutely any AI idea after finishing?
unverified_examples.reason: The course describes learning opportunities, not universal guarantees.
